action.details: Matches RewriteBar's generic PopClip integration: ActionClip copies the selection to the general clipboard, then opens rewritebar://command-menu so RewriteBar can read it.
action.exampleOutput: RewriteBar opens its command menu with the selection on the clipboard.
action.name: RewriteBar
action.privacySummary: ActionClip places the selected text on the local clipboard and passes control to RewriteBar. RewriteBar's configured provider determines whether the text is processed locally or online.
action.requirements: RewriteBar must be installed. This integration intentionally replaces the current clipboard contents.
action.summary: Open RewriteBar's command menu for the selected text.
